pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is largest on the flank, becoming smaller and more densely packed towards the neck and shoulder. Geometric shapes vary from triangles to complex quadrilaterals with rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent intersections. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, showing slight widening at junction points and narrowing along the parallel edges of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the mane. The profile shows a dark brown, fibrous texture that contrasts with the lighter skin of the neck and the blurred background.
